events.title: ACP and Instant Checkout launched
events.detail: OpenAI and Stripe open-sourced ACP; US Etsy sellers live, Shopify merchants announced; Stripe introduced SPTs.

events.title: Walmart announces Instant Checkout plans
events.detail: Customers would soon shop Walmart in ChatGPT.

events.title: PayPal says it will adopt ACP
events.detail: PayPal plans an ACP server for its merchants.

events.title: Target app in ChatGPT announced
events.detail: OpenAI and Target announce a Target app in ChatGPT, launching in beta the following week with checkout through the user's Target account.

events.title: Collaboration and Governance Agreement
events.detail: The Collaboration and Governance Agreement behind the CLA is dated 2025-11-21; Stripe and OpenAI signed the CLA that day.

events.title: Stripe Agentic Commerce Suite
events.detail: Stripe launches seller tooling with named brands and platforms.

events.title: Version 2025-12-12
events.detail: fulfillment_details, selected_fulfillment_options, intent traces, affiliate attribution; the schema adds the authentication_required status.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot Checkout
events.detail: Microsoft says it adopts open standards like ACP.

events.title: Version 2026-01-16
events.detail: Merchants name their 3DS authentication provider; adyen added.

events.title: 4 percent Shopify fee reported
events.detail: Trade report via The Information; not published by OpenAI.

events.title: Version 2026-01-30
events.detail: Capability negotiation, payment handlers, extensions, eleven statuses.

events.title: TSC governance model
events.detail: Up to 7 seats appointed by OpenAI and Stripe; SEPs; founders' veto.

events.title: Instant Checkout "moving to apps" reported
events.detail: Trade press quoting an OpenAI spokesperson via The Information.

events.title: OpenAI shifts ACP to product discovery
events.detail: Merchants use their own checkout; seven retailers named for discovery.

events.title: Walmart app in ChatGPT available on the web
events.detail: OpenAI says the Walmart in-ChatGPT app with account linking, loyalty and Walmart payments is available in web browsers; Retail Dive reports it on 2026-03-25.

events.title: Version 2026-04-17
events.detail: Cart, Feed API, Delegate Authentication, acp.json discovery, MCP binding, required Idempotency-Key.

events.title: Meta joins the TSC
events.detail: Seat 3.

events.title: Released 2026-04-17 schema edited
events.detail: Order schema alignment changes the released snapshot.

events.title: Etsy app in ChatGPT in beta (reported)
events.detail: Retail Dive (2026-05-14) reports the Etsy app live in beta, citing a 2026-05-05 post by Etsy's product chief; users click through to Etsy to buy.

events.title: Last commit to date
events.detail: Optional product url on checkout items (unreleased); no commits, releases or maintainer comments through 2026-10-20.

events.title: Dispute-resolution extension proposed (PR 316)
events.detail: A community SEP proposes a dispute-resolution extension for agent-initiated transactions and awaits a TSC sponsor; issue 315 (2026-10-15) asks for stored agent identity. No maintainer reply through 2026-10-20.
